head: YOUR MONDAY.
*47 UNREAD.*

beats.say: You can hire help. Interviews, training, payroll. Or you can type one sentence.
head: HIRE HELP?
*OR ONE SENTENCE.*

beats.say: Sort these. Draft the replies. Tell me what needs me.
head: ONE
*SENTENCE.*

scene.text: sort these, draft the replies, tell me what needs me

beats.say: Seven agents wake up. Inbox, follow ups, quotes, bookings, reviews, invoices, and a morning brief.
head: 7 AGENTS
*WAKE UP.*

head: THEY DO
*THE BUSY WORK.*

beats.say: Every draft waits for your OK. Nothing sends on its own.
head: IT DRAFTS.
*YOU SEND.*
